items.title: 63520_Ernie Fields oral history interview
items.q: Melvin was in the band a long time after that accident, because he got back straight on, way before he got with Diz.

ctx.x: Estelle Edwards stayed with you a while?
Oh, yes, she went on. Of course Melvin was in the band a long time after that accident, because he got back straight on, way before he got with Diz.

I would tell you one incident that happened, but you may know the gentleman, he was from London, who interviewed me, and it looked like he was interested in everything that did happen bad and I'll tell you about one little incident.
